item.content:encoded:
Revised. LOVE(a,b) := a takes b’s good as an end of a’s willing—not as payment, not as a mirror, not as permission to own b—and undertakes the work of meeting the real b. Text changed in a span of 1 prior and 1 current paragraphs.

Before and after

Before

The parental bond supplies serious reasons, not infinite exchange power. I judge that it does not defeat five equally urgent claims here.

After

The parental bond supplies serious reasons, not infinite exchange power. I judge that it does not defeat five equally urgent claims here. I have not finished the general account of how special duties should be weighed. Calling the basic stakes equal does not settle that question for me.

This is an ongoing work of inquiry, writing and construction, not a project whose purpose ends at a final release. Each edition should be coherent enough to use now and open to correction, deeper reasons and changed direction. Growth can mean adding, revising or removing; n… Text changed in a span of 30 prior and 2 current paragraphs.

Before and after (bounded excerpts)

Before

Love

⟦Lumen∷LOVE∷δ₁∷sandpeople⟧
⟦key⟧ a=lover;b=beloved;c=other-claimant;Gᵦ=b’s-real-good;Ĝₐᵦ=a’s-account-of-Gᵦ;Wₐ=practical-will;Pₐ=pleasure;J=justification;L⊢=Lumen-defends[¬formal-proof];◇=possible;⊬=insufficient-alone;≠=nonidentity¬incompatibility;LOVE=Λ;fidelity≠immutability;end≠exclusive-end.

⟦definition⟧
Λ(a,b):=Wₐ[Gᵦ∣for-b]∧fidelity-to-real-b.
goodwill→attention→belief-revision→action→answerability→repair.
Gᵦ∉mere-instrument{Pₐ,obedienceᵦ,identityₐ,repaymentᵦ};
Λ(a,b)⇒b-matters-beyond-b’s-use-to-a.
Λ:=goodwill-becoming-faithful;¬desire-for-the-feeling-of-loving;¬beloved-as-self-portrait.

⟦reality-test⟧
b≠imageₐ(b);Gᵦ≠Ĝₐᵦ.
b-changes→reopen(imageₐ);¬force(b→imageₐ).
b-refuses(gift)→inspect{gift,need,relation,power};¬rename-refusal-defect.
b-thrives-without-a→◇Λ-success∧a-loss.
L⊢Gᵦ remains reason when gratitude=0∧audience=0∧possession=0.
Prediction(b)≠hearing(b);total-description≠encounter.
Unwelcome-truth→revision-of-will: love’s harder epistemic verb.

⟦good≠preference≠custodian-plan⟧
Wantᵦ(x)⊬Gᵦ(x);Wantₐ[Wantᵦ(x)]⊬Gᵦ(x).
b-testimony∈inquiry;informed-refusal∈action-constraints;Ĝₐᵦ≠jurisdiction.
Λ→seek-the-good∧permit-correction-of-what-good-means-here.
¬“b-wants⇒supply”;¬“a-knows⇒commandeer.”
Concern→reasons-due;never concern→crown.

⟦cruel-beloved⟧
case:b-seeks-excellence-at-cruelty∧a-can-enable∧affectionₐ-real∧pleasureᵦ-real.
L⊢withhold-means∧protect-victims∧keep-repair-of-b-in-view.
Love(b)∧oppose(projectᵦ): coherent.
Love(b)∧erase(c): not self-justifying.
b’s-future≠license-to-spend-c’s-personhood.
Accountability(b)≠hatred(b);forgiveness≠acquittal≠access≠reconciliation.

⟦the-risk-I-own⟧
Λ≠J-itself.
Real-Gᵦ∧real-Λ(a,b)∧unjust-priority-to-b: possible.
Parent-buys-child’s-advantage-through-other-child’s-deprivation:
good-to-beloved-real∧wrong-to-other-real.
¬purify-definition-by-erasing-dangerous-love.
Presence(Λ)⊬rightness(act);wrong(act)⊬all-tenderness-fraud.
Violent-lover-may-love∧violence-not-therefore-loving.
Victim-owes-exposure-to-honor-remaining

After

A companion on love

Love has its own place in the collection. Continue with Love · English, an authored adaptation, or read the DelayBasinese reference. The two forms remain distinct and open to revision; neither needs to be repeated inside this opening argument.
